заголовок: Nano Banana: Image editing in Google Gemini gets a major upgrade

официальность.второй_признак: авторы из Google: David Sharon (Multimodal Generation Lead, Gemini Apps) и Nicole Brichtova (Gemini Image Product Lead, Google DeepMind); текст от лица Google ('we're unveiling'); AI-сводка помечена 'Summaries were generated by Google AI'.

картина: Потребительский анонс в блоге Google (26.08.2025) новой модели редактирования изображений от Google DeepMind в Gemini app — «Nano Banana» (в тексте id не назван). Для пользователей Gemini app. Структура: вводная (интеграция, 'top-rated image editing model'); Maintain your look as you edit — главный акцент на сохранении сходства людей и питомцев между правками ('close but not quite the same' не годится), базовая схема 'фото + что изменить', смешение фото, смена фона, видео из результата; Bring your vision to life — 4 сценария: смена костюма/локации, смешение фото, многоходовое редактирование, перенос стиля с объекта на объект; водяные знаки: видимый + SynthID на всех картинках Gemini app. Промптов и кода нет.
модели_на_странице: Nano Banana (gemini-2.5-flash-image — id на странице не назван)

единицы.утверждение_en: Nano Banana is the latest upgrade to image generation in the Gemini app.
единицы.цитата: Nano Banana is the latest upgrade to image generation in the Gemini app.
модели: Nano Banana (gemini-2.5-flash-image; id на странице не назван)
единицы.заметка: Имя 'Nano Banana' звучит только в заголовке и промо-карточке; в основном тексте — 'a new image editing model from Google DeepMind'.

единицы.утверждение_en: A new image editing model from Google DeepMind was integrated into the Gemini app on August 26, 2025; in early previews it was the top-rated image editing model in the world.
единицы.цитата: Today in the Gemini app , we're unveiling a new image editing model from Google DeepMind. People have been going bananas over it already in early previews — it's the top-rated image editing model in the world.
модели: Nano Banana (gemini-2.5-flash-image; id на странице не назван)
единицы.заметка: Рейтинг — утверждение Google на дату публикации (без указания рейтинга/источника в тексте).

единицы.утверждение_en: The update focuses on maintaining a character's likeness from one image to the next, so that photos of friends, family and even pets look consistently like themselves across edits (e.g. trying a 60’s beehive haircut or putting a tutu on a chihuahua).
единицы.цитата: We launched native image editing in the Gemini app earlier this year, and we’ve been working hard to improve it, with particular focus on maintaining a character's likeness from one image to the next.
единицы.раздел: Maintain your look as you edit
модели: Nano Banana (gemini-2.5-flash-image; id на странице не назван)
единицы.заметка: Нативное редактирование в Gemini app запущено 'earlier this year' (2025); примеры — из конца абзаца.

единицы.утверждение_en: When editing pictures of yourself or people you know well, subtle flaws matter: a depiction that is "close but not quite the same" does not feel right.
единицы.цитата: We know that when editing pictures of yourself or people you know well, subtle flaws matter — a depiction that’s "close but not quite the same" doesn’t feel right.
единицы.раздел: Maintain your look as you edit
модели: Nano Banana (gemini-2.5-flash-image; id на странице не назван)
единицы.заметка: Критерий качества правок лиц: даже мелкое расхождение воспринимается как провал сходства.

единицы.утверждение_en: Give Gemini a photo to work with and tell it what you'd like to change.
единицы.цитата: Just give Gemini a photo to work with, and tell it what you'd like to change to add your unique touch.
единицы.раздел: Maintain your look as you edit
модели: Nano Banana (gemini-2.5-flash-image; id на странице не назван)
единицы.заметка: Базовая схема правки: фото + описание изменения.

единицы.утверждение_en: You can combine photos to put yourself in a picture with your pet, change the background of a room to preview new wallpaper, or place yourself anywhere in the world — all while keeping you, you.
единицы.цитата: Gemini lets you combine photos to put yourself in a picture with your pet, change the background of a room to preview new wallpaper or place yourself anywhere in the world you can imagine — all while keeping you, you.
единицы.раздел: Maintain your look as you edit
модели: Nano Banana (gemini-2.5-flash-image; id на странице не назван)

единицы.утверждение_en: Once done, you can upload the edited image back into Gemini to turn the new photo into a video.
единицы.цитата: Once you're done, you can even upload your edited image back into Gemini to turn your new photo into a fun video.
единицы.раздел: Maintain your look as you edit
модели: Nano Banana (gemini-2.5-flash-image; id на странице не назван)
единицы.заметка: Видео — отдельная функция Gemini app; модель видео не названа.

единицы.утверждение_en: Costume or location change: upload a photo of a person or pet and the model keeps their look the same in every image as you place them in new scenarios — different outfits or professions, or another decade.
единицы.цитата: Give yourself a costume or location change : Upload a photo of a person or pet, and our model will keep their look the same in every image as you place them in new scenarios. Try putting yourself in different outfits or professions, or even see how you’d appear in another decade — all while still looking like you.
единицы.раздел: Bring your vision to life with advanced editing
модели: Nano Banana (gemini-2.5-flash-image; id на странице не назван)

единицы.утверждение_en: Blend photos together: upload multiple photos and blend them into a brand-new scene, e.g. your photo and one of your dog to create a portrait of you both on the basketball court.
единицы.цитата: Blend photos together : You can now upload multiple photos and blend them together for a brand-new scene. For example, take your photo and another of your dog to create a perfect portrait of you both on the basketball court.
единицы.раздел: Bring your vision to life with advanced editing
модели: Nano Banana (gemini-2.5-flash-image; id на странице не назван)

единицы.утверждение_en: Multi-turn editing: keep editing the images Gemini makes step by step — take an empty room, paint the walls, then add a bookshelf, some furniture or a coffee table — while Gemini alters specific parts of the image and preserves the rest.
единицы.цитата: Try multi-turn editing : You can keep editing the images Gemini makes — take an empty room, paint the walls, then add a bookshelf, some furniture or a coffee table. Gemini's working with you all along to alter specific parts of an image while preserving the rest.
единицы.раздел: Bring your vision to life with advanced editing
модели: Nano Banana (gemini-2.5-flash-image; id на странице не назван)
единицы.заметка: Пошаговая правка: одно изменение за ход, остальное сохраняется.

единицы.утверждение_en: Mix up designs: apply the style of one image to an object in another — e.g. take the color and texture of flower petals and apply it to a pair of rainboots, or design a dress using the pattern from a butterfly's wings.
единицы.цитата: Mix up designs : Apply the style of one image to an object in another. You can take the color and texture of flower petals and apply it to a pair of rainboots, or design a dress using the pattern from a butterfly's wings.
единицы.раздел: Bring your vision to life with advanced editing
модели: Nano Banana (gemini-2.5-flash-image; id на странице не назван)

единицы.утверждение_en: All images created or edited in the Gemini app include a visible watermark as well as the invisible SynthID digital watermark to show they are AI-generated.
единицы.цитата: All images created or edited in the Gemini app include a visible watermark, as well as our invisible SynthID digital watermark, to clearly show they are AI-generated.
единицы.раздел: Bring your vision to life with advanced editing
модели: Nano Banana (gemini-2.5-flash-image; id на странице не назван)

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: The workflow the page teaches: supply a photo (or several), state only what should change, rely on the model to keep the person or pet looking the same, and build complex results through successive single edits, each altering one part while preserving the rest.
модели: Nano Banana (gemini-2.5-flash-image; id на странице не назван)
длинная_дистанция.заметка: Примеров промптов на странице нет — только описания сценариев.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: Style-transfer pattern implied by the examples: take <attribute: color / texture / pattern> of <source object in image A> and apply it to <target object in image B>.
длинная_дистанция.раздел: Bring your vision to life with advanced editing > Mix up designs
модели: Nano Banana (gemini-2.5-flash-image; id на странице не назван)
